scientific_integrity: The moment formulas are elementary identities, not original. The specific minimal cardinality, unique first collision and all-larger-size construction are the claimed new results. Least-period-set literature is credited.
scientific_limitations: Same-cardinality uniform finite permutations only; no cross-size or nonuniform-measure classification, and no complete list of collisions above fourteen. Complete finite recurrence is available; external independent review has not been performed.
title: The sharp fourteen-point ambiguity of least-period mean and variance
